# Train Travel Calculation

## Given Information
- **Speed**: 60 km/h
- **Time**: 2.5 hours
- **Unknown**: Distance travelled (km)

## Solution Steps

The relationship between these three quantities is:
$$\text{Distance} = \text{Speed} \times \text{Time}$$

This is because speed is defined as distance per unit time, so multiplying speed by time gives the distance covered.
